A '''subspace relay station''' was used to broadcast news through [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and transmit [[Subscape Communications|subspace communication]] signals.<ref name="Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>

The subspace relay station in the [[Laim system/Legends|Laim system]] was a 100 meter-long, spindle-shaped, unmanned, intra-system space station in a distant orbit around its star. In addition to broadcasting systems, the station had a collision defense system. This defense system had 12 lasers arrayed around the station's radial exterior, designed to destroy any orbiting asteroids or planetoids which might have threatened to collide with the station. It was also fitted with defensive [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]].

Not all subspace relay station have the capability to originate broadcasts. Some can only relay broadcasts. In the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]], for example, only eight of sixty-four relay stations (including the station at Laim) had the capability to originate broadcasts, the rest only having the capability to relay.<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
